commitments.detail: The licensed field is defined as energy-storage products based on the request from HelioGrid.
Exclusivity is granted worldwide as requested by HelioGrid.
A royalty rate of 5% is set to balance the interests of both parties.
A minimum annual royalty of $500,000 is established to ensure a baseline revenue stream.
Government use reservation is included to comply with potential government contracts.
